set.body:
Review and tighten the motion public surface before adding more features.

Contracts: no R S3/list-shaped control leakage; closed alternatives are enums; domain scalars are opaque where useful; constructors validate at boundaries; failures return MotionError or Either; profiles expose implemented and planned capabilities as values.

Deliverables: typed SliceTiming/PacketTiming shells, MotionCorrectionResult or equivalent workflow result, residual/whitening/capture policies as ADTs, and any needed smart constructors replacing ad-hoc booleans or strings.

Acceptance: scaladoc/README examples use the final public shape; invalid settings are unrepresentable or typed errors; existing users can inspect a plan before execution; motionJVM/test and motionJS/test remain green.
set.title: Audit motion public API for Oderskyan Scala 3 domain shape
